rule_note: Phone/device cannot run the app, slow or crashing -> D7. D8 only when the reviewer links it to an app update or OS version change.
Transaction failed, stuck or money missing -> D1 (no network mention needed). D4 = flow design: confirmation, mis-send, undo, too many steps.
D6 only for language/script problems (Bangla display or typing). A bug in a flow is coded by the flow it breaks (OTP box broken -> D2).
Phone/device cannot run the app, slow or crashing -> D7. D8 only when the reviewer links it to an app update or OS version change.
Review names the interface/usability ('UI', 'not user-friendly', 'cannot find') -> D11. N5 only if no aspect is named.
Transfer to/from a bank, card or another service fails -> D12. Transfer inside the app fails -> D1.
Opening or verifying a NEW account -> D5. Getting into an EXISTING account (login, OTP, PIN) -> D2.
